viewing_check: Read hallmarks on jug, napkin rings and tongs (lion passant, city, date letter, maker); weigh the lot if allowed; check whether any napkin ring is Australian-made (maker names like Hardy Bros, Stewart Dawson, Wendt) or the jug is genuinely Georgian; note dents and any engraving or monograms.
